$10K Degree Completion Program Locations

The $10K Degree Completion Program is available at Texas Tech DFW and Texas Tech El Paso, providing an affordable, flexible way for students to complete their degrees. With personalized support and convenient locations in Dallas-Fort Worth and El Paso, this program helps students advance their education and careers close to home.

Can you tell me more about your online programs?

TTU Online offers a wide range of undergraduate and graduate degrees designed for flexibility, accessibility, and career alignment, delivered in accelerated 8-week formats. We have programs in the social sciences, pre-health, business, leadership, communication, etc.

Does the online degree program allow for hybrid classes?

All TTU Online programs are fully asynchronous online. However there are some hybrid degree options through TTU Lubbock.

Can I take Online+ right out of high school or do I have to do in person classes?

Online+ is available to students after high school graduation who are attending college for the first time. Online+ is available to those with a high school diploma or GED. If the program you want to study is available online, you are not required to study on-campus and can complete your degree 100% online if relocating to the main campus is not an option.

Are all of the online programs at TTU 8 weeks long?

No, Online+ programs use 8-week terms, while some traditional programs may still follow 16-week formats.

Why are students being asked to pause their application?

The program is transitioning from the traditional 16-week format to the new Online+ 8-week model.

To ensure applicants apply under the correct structure and receive accurate program information, they are asked to wait until the updated Online+ application becomes available.

Up to 21 Free Credit Hours* Available

*When you combine your prior learning credit with free microcredentials you can potentially earn up to 21 hours of credit towards degree completion at no cost.
